nativity_of_the_lord.title: The Nativity of the Lord
nativity_of_the_lord.description: Christmas Day — we celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ.

easter_sunday.title: Easter Sunday
easter_sunday.description: Christ is risen! Alleluia! We celebrate the Resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ.

ash_wednesday.description: We begin our Lenten journey with prayer, repentance, and a renewed commitment to follow Christ.

holy_thursday.title: Maundy Thursday
holy_thursday.description: We remember the Last Supper and Jesus' commandment to love one another as he has loved us.

friday_of_the_passion_of_the_lord.title: Good Friday
friday_of_the_passion_of_the_lord.description: We reflect on the Passion and death of Jesus Christ and his saving love for the world.

holy_saturday.title: Black Saturday
holy_saturday.description: We wait in prayer and hope, remembering Christ in the tomb and looking forward to the joy of Easter.

advent_1_sunday.description: We begin Advent in prayerful preparation for the coming of Christ and the start of a new liturgical year.

supplements.title: Santo Niño
supplements.description: The Philippine feast of Santo Niño, the Holy Child Jesus.
